name: fix90_bow_aim
verifies: fix-90: with a bow the focus follows the crosshair (G3 PS_Ranged: camera heading, ±45°, no range rating; G3 camera has no shoulder offset); a boar fighting the focused wolf is still focusable (the ranged states do not make the focus the hero's CurrentTarget); an arrow loosed with the crosshair on a scavenger hits it; a drawn weapon focuses no objects/items (G3 Melee/Ranged/MagicMode Item/InteractPriority -1)
steps: spawn Scavenger attitude=neutral near=$a dist=5 side=left as=b
spawn Boar attitude=neutral near=$bandit dist=4 side=right as=boar
notes: Before fix-90: (1) the camera hung 0.35 m right of the head, so the screen centre ran beside the hero and the focus azimuth (G3: from the hero, along the camera heading) disagreed with the crosshair; (2) the hero's 'current target' was the ranged focus itself, so a boar fighting the focused bandit got GetFocusEntityPriority -1 and could never be focused; (3) with a weapon drawn and no combat focus the HUD fell back to the PS_Normal focus (chests, items, signposts). The boar and bandit fight each other and move: aimat re-aims every frame for secs. If the bandit fights the hero instead, priorities differ (G3: the hero as target -> 3 wins over the angle) — check the engage log. fix-96 (r38): (1) facing yaw 35 a 0.3 m buckthorn trunk (G3_Tree_S_CarolinaBuckthorn_02) stood 1.5 m before Scavenger b on the line from the hero's eyes: no free line of sight, so G3 FocusCheck drops it and a stays focused (correct); the hero now faces the open meadow (yaw 100). (2) a Montera bandit is Hostile to the hero whatever spawn attitude= says (outlaws vs humans, IsOutlawPair), so fighting he has PS_Ranged priority 2 against the neutral boar's 1 and keeps the focus (G3 GetFocusEntityPriority, correct); the boar now fights a neutral wolf (both priority 1, the angle decides). Var $bandit is the wolf. The signpost part needs interactiveObjects.json with Sign entries (r37). fix-105 (r40): the nearest Sign_Faring has a hanged corpse (G3_Object_Corpse_Hanged_01, own collision) right in front of its board, so from the front the focus line of sight (fix-104, G3 IsFreeLOS) is blocked by it, as in G3; the hero reads it from the back.
